sampling: All eligible Standard FRM origination IDs; SHA256 namespace identifier-only rank, digest then ID, first min(N,eligible). No outcomes/credit/geography/history in selection.
source_release_adapter: Pinned official R47 July2026 31 origination/35 performance positions; fail closed on differences. Archive timestamps are not release proof.
horizon_origin: First observed reporting month, conditional on active known state. No inferred origination date. horizon h means h monthly intervals from that boundary.

horizon_support_rule.rule: Both risk support and known cause/status count must meet threshold; otherwise UNSUPPORTED. No future outcomes extrapolated.

endpoint_count_rule: First observed default/payoff/administrative/ambiguous category across sorted complete retained source history; active_or_unknown otherwise, exactly as Task4/6 descriptive endpoints. Distinct from gap/unknown-censored analytical follow-up.
risk_rule: First contiguous active known prefix from first observed month through first clinical endpoint, ambiguity, admin, unknown or gap. Never re-enter. Preserve/quarantine later raw rows. Duplicate months stop analytical prefix.
future_constraints: national macro replacing unrestricted period FE
record_authorization: User supplied seven local Standard archives in response to explicit official-source acquisition instructions; no authentication automated; exact download times unknown.
